description: Request payload for updating a collection. Only the fields supplied in the request payload will have an effect. Only one of `setItems`, addItems`, `moveItems`, and `removeItems` can be non-empty in a single request.

name.description: The human-readable name of the collection.

public.description: `true` if the collection should be visible to all users, `false` otherwise.

setItems.description: Replace the list of items with the ones provided. Each item must occur at most once.

removeItems.description: Remove the items at the specified positions from the collection.
